scope: C07 historical completed-result consumer and recipient authority

findings.observed: validateRecord is shared by admission, start and result reads; it requires exact current case version, resolveInputs with fresh-only C17 resolution, current source equality, and executable publication revalidation. Completed artifacts with valid immutable terminal receipts therefore cannot be reopened after a legitimate source/case version advance.
findings.publicationCorrection: RelayWorkflowBinding.revalidate reacquires expected.publication as a pinned immutable version. A later draft or republication alone does not replace or reject that pin. Unpublish/archive and skill/materialization/knowledge changes can reject it. Removing revalidate on the premise that it always follows the latest version is incorrect.
findings.missingEvidence: The native adapter is not installed in host-context. SfRoutineNativeRecord retains opaque inputRefs and SourceRef[], but no authoritative original BusinessEvidenceRef[] mapping. Current case evidence cannot reconstruct evidence removed or advanced since admission. C07 output currently has no explicit fresh/historical/currentRef/differences envelope.
findings.boundedSeam: Keep prepareAdmission/readAdmission/start strict. A separate completed-result read must consume the actual immutable native admission, original C17 refs, exact run/result/input/output/terminal revision tuple, physical case/source continuity and current caller/source ACL. Revalidate before and after artifact read. Return original pins plus explicit historical status/currentRef/differences through an owner-approved C07/C06 envelope; never relabel original output as fresh or rewrite its digest.
proofRequirements: real governed admission/start/terminal receipt and artifact digest
completed historical result opens after case/source version advance with original pins and explicit stale display
prepare/start remain stale after the same advance
physical replacement, revoked ACL, cancellation, changed terminal receipt, provider replacement and output corruption deny without payload
sf_routine_result authorization is reacquired on each open/preserve; sf_review_prepare is not reused
findings.disposition: No source relaxation or native-provider stub supplied. Consumer implementation remains blocked on producer retention/proof and approved historical envelope. Current C17 historical staging is not treated as published evidence for this pin.

findings.observed: createCollaborationHost receives issueForActor/prepareReissueScope but no recipientAuthority. Cross-recipient writes fail closed. Directory membership and data.access[id] only locate a person; caller authentication does not establish the selected person's permissions.
findings.boundedSeam: Inject an existing trusted host-private CollaborationRecipientAuthority through createSfBusinessServices into createCollaborationHost only when a real authoritative provider exists. authorize must resolve recipient access to every exact evidence field/period using current domain authority without forging a Request. checkAtCommit must synchronously check the matching host-private lease and current revocation/generation while the transaction owner checks current C08 source and caller fences; no nested I/O transaction or cached boolean.
proofRequirements: real two-user positive cycle with current exact recipient access
field/period narrowing, membership/ACL revocation and provider replacement between authorize and commit deny atomically
different caller, recipient, project, evidence, physical incarnation or concurrent invocation cannot borrow a lease
failed commit authority leaves no relation/thread/handoff write
findings.disposition: No authoritative arbitrary-recipient identity/permission producer exists in the inspected host APIs. No grant, synthetic recipient Request, role-name inference or placeholder authority is introduced. Missing injection alone is insufficient to implement the behavior safely.

nextAction: Owners supply the original native C07 evidence/terminal producer and recipient-authority proof boundary; WP10 then composes the explicit consumers and surgical regression checks. Existing cross-recipient and missing-native fail-closed behavior remains.
